department: DASHH, Data Science in Hamburg, Helmholtz Graduate School for the Structure of Matter

deadline.value: Applications are made for specific open PhD topics, each with its own form; no general deadline is stated on the DASHH pages.
deadline.quote: You can apply for up to two PhD research topics.

gre_subject.value: The DASHH pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The DASHH pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get a three-year work contract at the German E13 salary level.
funding.quote: Three-year work contract at the level of the German EGR. 13 salary scheme

entry_route.value: You need a master's degree, or an expected graduation date in the year of application, in computer science, applied mathematics or natural sciences.
entry_route.quote: To apply for our program, you must hold a Master's Degree or Diploma (or an estimated graduation date within the year of application) in computer science, applied mathematics, or natural sciences

notes: Listed on the MIN Faculty structured-programmes page under Informatik. It is run by DESY's Helmholtz graduate school, so its rules come from the DASHH pages, not the MIN doctoral regulations. A third-party listing of an earlier call deadline was not used because it is not on an official page.
name: Data Science in Hamburg (DASHH)
